doc.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995

title: Closing tributes
summary: Williams calls Terry beyond category and friend; Terry thanks him and they close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah, that one lasted. It still, “Every Day I have the Blues” I do it now. All right. Clark Terry. The man that Ellington said — and Ellington was never wrong, believe me — he said he was “beyond category.” And I am most grateful to be able to call him friend.

Well I’ll tell you Joe, I’ve had the pleasure of being a friend of yours and very close associate of yours for a very long period of time, and I’m looking forward to continuing. So God bless you and straight ahead, and all the best to you.
